headline: Elecnor Advances Solar Energy Projects in Peru to Secure PPAs
summary: Spanish infrastructure group Elecnor is advancing three solar photovoltaic projects across Peru to secure power purchase agreements and build long-term revenue streams.
why: Developing utility-scale renewable energy projects under power purchase agreements secures predictable cash flows for engineering firms expanding into emerging markets.

impacts.name: Elecnor
impacts.why: New renewable infrastructure projects expand operational asset bases and long-term revenue potential.
